beschreibung: An overview of Qwen-Image-2.1, highlighting native transparency, local editing tools, and licensing restrictions.

teile.text: How can you edit photos without losing style consistency? The new Qwen-Image-2.1 model solves this exact design problem.
teile.szene: Our channel presenter stands in front of a lively painted urban game-poster backdrop, pointing to a glowing digital canvas.

teile.text: It is a unified tool for visual generation and editing. This architecture relies on a visual component with 7 billion parameters.
teile.szene: A stylized graphic shows a split screen merging text input on the left with a colorful digital painting on the right.

teile.text: The system works natively with transparent RGBA files. This lets you create background-free elements like digital stickers. You extract complex subjects from photographs with ease.
teile.szene: A digital character is pulled cleanly away from its background, leaving a checkered transparency pattern behind it.

teile.text: You can upload up to 10 reference images at once. This preserves the exact identity of your key subjects. It works reliably for both people and products.
teile.szene: A grid of ten diverse portraits of the same stylized character morphs smoothly into a unified group photo.

teile.text: You direct local edits using circles or painted annotations. The model applies changes only to those marked areas. This provides fine control without altering your entire background.
teile.szene: A digital hand draws a glowing neon circle around a character's jacket, which instantly changes from blue to bright red.

teile.text: Its compact design uses mixed-granularity attention for better efficiency. It reuses its prefix key-value cache to lower computational costs. This lightweight setup ensures fast, high-quality image creation.
teile.szene: The presenter reappears in the painted urban setting, holding a tablet displaying complex texture edits on a digital shoe.

teile.text: Creators can build polished marketing graphics with realistic textures. However, the tool operates under a restrictive research license. This agreement limits the model to non-commercial evaluation.
teile.szene: A close-up reveals a research document icon transforming into a locked padlock symbol over a digital image editor interface.

teile.text: The model maintains your style by referencing your selected layouts. It answers the need for consistent, professional visual updates.
teile.szene: A close-up reveals intricate lace textures and sharp typography on a digital poster package, looking highly polished.

teile.text: Please like, share and save this video for more. Enjoy editing your images with these advanced AI tools.
teile.szene: A vibrant end screen with animated buttons representing the like, share, and save actions lighting up in sequence.
